_help: Creature rungs, §ED.5 (4 Oct 2026). Every species gets three: common (creatures.json as is), rare (tint only, chance), mythic (variant mesh/silhouette, own voice, multipliers on the species' own numbers, rarer chance). guardian: may be bound to the ground outside an overrun ruin (§ED.6). Only two placeholders here; the rest is a chat data fill.

guardians._help: Design 4 Oct §ED.6 (added by Claude Code, 5 Oct): guardians. share: of the overrun ruins (§CN), how many have a mythic with guardian true holding the ground outside (seeded per ruin). hold_m: how far round its ground it ranges (the ground lies ground_out_m beyond the ruin's door). slow_mps: a walker no faster than this it closes on; run_mps: a runner at least this fast spooks it off for spook_s seconds. drive_off_game_h: a wound from spear or bow drives it off for this many game hours. bite: what its bite does (Harm counts hits). It ignores light, and ranges out from dusk until dawn to hunt. When the ruin's hearth is restored (the ruin no longer overrun) it leaves for good.
